title: Create 2-page Funngro (Teen) marketing site with SEO-friendly content

requirements.text: Implement a 2-page, responsive marketing website experience for Funngro inspired by the layout/content structure of the funngro.com “Teen” page, with clear navigation between the two pages.

quotes: go the the website funngro.com click on the teen page and create a 2 page design for Funngro

acceptanceCriteria: App has exactly two primary pages/routes accessible via top navigation and clear CTAs (e.g., header links/buttons).
Both pages are mobile-first and adapt cleanly to tablet/desktop (no overlapping content; spacing and typography scale appropriately).
Page structure uses semantic sections (header, main, section, footer) and consistent components (hero, benefits, steps, testimonials/quotes, FAQ, footer).

requirements.text: Create Page 1 (Teen Landing) with SEO-friendly, English marketing copy that targets teens: a hero section with value proposition, key benefits, a simple “How it works” overview, trust signals (stats or short quotes), and a primary call-to-action section.

quotes: click on the teen page and create a 2 page design for Funngro, make sure to implement  SEO freindly content

acceptanceCriteria: Teen Landing page contains: a single H1, multiple scannable H2 sections, short paragraphs, and bullet lists where appropriate.
Copy is written in English and is SEO-oriented (includes relevant terms like “teen freelancing”, “paid projects for teens”, “earn money as a teen”, without keyword stuffing).
Primary CTA is visually prominent above the fold and repeated near the bottom of the page.
Footer includes internal links to the second page and core sections (e.g., How it works, FAQ).

requirements.text: Create Page 2 (Teen Details) that expands on the Teen Landing with SEO-friendly, English content: detailed steps, eligibility/requirements, safety/trust explanation, FAQs, and a secondary call-to-action.

quotes: create a 2 page design for Funngro, make sure to implement  SEO freindly content

acceptanceCriteria: Teen Details page contains: a single H1 distinct from Page 1, logical H2/H3 hierarchy, and an FAQ section with question headings and concise answers.
Includes internal links back to the Teen Landing page and to key sections within the page (anchor links if used).
Content is clearly targeted to teen intent (what you do, how you get projects, how payments/verification works at a high level, safety).

requirements.text: Add SEO-ready metadata and structure for both pages: unique document titles, meta descriptions, canonical URL strategy (configurable), and accessible/semantic markup that supports search indexing.
acceptanceCriteria: Each page sets a unique document title and meta description (no duplicates).
Pages have exactly one H1 each, descriptive H2s, and meaningful link text (no “click here”).
All images used in-page have descriptive alt text.
Site includes a basic robots meta policy (index/follow) and is ready to add canonical URLs without code refactor (e.g., centralized metadata config per route).

requirements.text: Apply a coherent, creative visual theme across the two pages (colors, typography, spacing, button styles, and section patterns) appropriate for a teen-focused brand; avoid a blue/purple default palette.
acceptanceCriteria: Both pages share a consistent design system (same button variants, typography scale, card styles, spacing rhythm).
Theme uses a distinct non-blue/purple-forward palette and looks intentional across headers, CTAs, and section backgrounds.
Interactive elements have clear hover/focus states and meet basic accessibility expectations (visible focus, readable contrast).

requirements.text: Add required static marketing images (generated assets) and render them on the two pages from the frontend public assets folder (do not serve them from the backend).
acceptanceCriteria: Generated images are placed under frontend/public/assets/generated and referenced directly by the frontend.
Images appear in the hero and/or section headers in a way that supports the overall layout without breaking responsiveness.
All rendered images include alt text aligned to what is visually depicted (not keyword stuffing).

constraints: Do not modify files under frontend/src/components/ui (compose these components instead).
Do not edit frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.tsx, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, or frontend/src/main.tsx (immutable paths).
No third-party authentication other than Internet Identity (not required for this request).
Do not add external databases or non-supported backend services.
nonGoals: Implementing sign-up/login flows, account management, or an application dashboard.
Building backend CRUD, data persistence, or admin panels.
Integrating third-party analytics, email/SMS providers, or social media APIs.
Scraping or automatically importing content from funngro.com; content should be newly authored and only inspired by the referenced Teen page structure.

required: Teen-focused hero illustration showing a teen using a laptop/phone with positive, modern flat style (funngro-teen-hero.dim_1600x900.png)
Set of 6 simple flat vector-style icons representing: projects, earnings, skills, safety, time flexibility, and mentorship (funngro-teen-icons.dim_512x512.png)
Warm abstract background texture/shape gradient (non-blue/purple dominant) (funngro-warm-bg.dim_1920x1080.png)
